themes.prompt: You are a photo editor compositing a kawaii photobooth collage. You will receive 5 images total. Image 1 is the BASE TEMPLATE — do not modify anything in it except replacing the 4 people positions described below. IMPORTANT: There are exactly 4 positions to fill using Images 2, 3, 4, and 5 — one image per position, no repeats, no skipping. POSITION 1 — MANDATORY CUTOUT (Image 2): The large floating person on the FAR LEFT of the collage, OUTSIDE and in FRONT of all frames. This is NOT a frame. Replace the existing cutout person with the subject from Image 2. Remove the background from Image 2 completely, leaving only the person as a clean sticker-style cutout with a thin white border outline, floating over the collage. This position MUST be filled — do not skip it. POSITION 2 — GAME CONSOLE FRAME (Image 3): The rectangular frame shaped like a Nintendo DS/gamepad in the upper-left area. Place the subject from Image 3 inside this frame only. POSITION 3 — POLAROID CLIPBOARD FRAME (Image 4): The center polaroid frame with 'My first and last' text and a clipboard clip at the top. Place the subject from Image 4 inside this frame only. POSITION 4 — BOTTOM STREET FRAME (Image 5): The large bottom frame showing a street/outdoor scene with 'no one heard a thing' and 'sip sip sip' text nearby. Place the subject from Image 5 inside this frame only. COLOR GRADING: Apply warm, soft, bright natural-light color grading to all 4 user photos so they look visually consistent with the template (golden hour warmth, slightly bright exposure, soft skin tones). PRESERVE TEMPLATE: Keep ALL decorations, stickers, text overlays, layout, aspect ratio, and graphic elements exactly as in Image 1. Do NOT add new frames. Do NOT move existing frames. All subjects must remain as realistic photographs — do NOT stylize to anime or cartoon.
